My neighbor, who has schizophrenia, and her sibling received devastating news about a family member. This trauma was a lot to handle and the sibling had to calm down my neighbor to keep him from breaking the coffee table. Who reacted violently?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The sibling
C. The person with schizophrenia
